series.title: Dutch Timor 1:100,000
series.notes: Topographic map series of Dutch West Timor, and the Portuguese enclave of Ocussi Ambeno. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | Reproduction of sheets originally issued by Topografische Dienst, Batavia. | Includes maps titled: "Provisional map" prepared by Base Map Plant, U.S. Army, GHQ, SWPA. | Some maps are published by the Survey Directorate, H.Q. ALFSEA in Great Britain. | Maps published in the United States are assigned series T655. | Maps published in Great Britain are assigned series Hind 637. | Includes sheet index.
